improvement.title: Run the node-check utility
improvement.text: Execute `node-check --verbose` and inspect the raw output.

en.title: Make repeated checks easier to understand
en.observation: Two synthetic checks produced the same unclear message.
en.impact: A reviewer cannot tell whether a new check failed.
en.change: Label each result with its actual run.
en.expectedResult: A reviewer can distinguish a new failure from an old message.

facts.text: The fixture contains two synthetic messages.

hypotheses: The messages may share a display label.
unknowns: The production cause is not evaluated by this fixture.

ru.title: Сделать повторные проверки понятнее
ru.observation: Две синтетические проверки показали одинаковое непонятное сообщение.
ru.impact: Проверяющий не может понять, была ли ошибка у новой проверки.
ru.change: Подписывать каждый результат по фактическому запуску.
ru.expectedResult: Проверяющий сможет отличить новую ошибку от старого сообщения.
unknowns: Причина в реальной системе этой фикстурой не проверяется.

cases.name: ready
cases.expected: Plain main explanation in both locales; original and technical quote only inside closed details.

cases.name: draft
cases.expected: Visible draft/not-ready state; no ready claim and no decision-status change.

cases.name: legacy
cases.expected: Original title and text remain accessible; no browser-invented explanation.

cases.name: missingLocale
cases.expected: Explicit incomplete-translation fallback, never an invented Russian text or ready state.

cases.name: unsafeURL
cases.expected: No clickable or navigable unsafe URL; source text remains inert.

cases.name: technicalQuote
cases.expected: Quote renders as text only inside details, without HTML execution or an automatic request.

cases.name: sourcechanged
cases.expected: Revision mismatch is reported; newer source is not silently replaced or shown as current.
